about: Questions written blind from merged PostHog/posthog PRs (2026) and a few common tasks, without seeing AGENTS.md; answers labeled separately against the docs `agentindex import` made from it.

labeling.method: Two independent labelers per question (one starting from the doc list, one from grep); a third agent reconciled every disagreement on the merits.

cases.task: fix(activity-logging): skip reads for fields a logged save cannot change
cases.question: How do I run just one backend Python test file, or a single test case, locally with pytest?
cases.note: Tests list: `hogli test path/to/test.py` and `hogli test path/to/test.py::TestClass::test_method` (pytest node id).

cases.task: chore(nodejs): control the clock in the CPU-call yield test
cases.question: How do I run the Node.js service tests locally, and do they need ClickHouse, Kafka or Postgres running?
cases.note: Universal `hogli test <file_or_directory>` auto-detects Jest; no doc says whether ClickHouse/Kafka/Postgres must run.

cases.task: chore(frontend): keep kea-test-utils off the authenticated shell
cases.question: How do I run a single frontend Jest test file, for example the tests for one Kea logic?
cases.note: Tests list: `hogli test <file_or_directory>` auto-detects Jest; pass the single logic test file.

cases.task: chore(tests): keep the team id sequence across test flushes
cases.question: A backend test passes locally but fails intermittently in CI; how do I check whether it's flaky and rerun it?
cases.note: Trunk Flaky Tests via the `trunk` MCP server checks per-test flakiness; rerunning CI jobs is not covered.

cases.task: fix(signals): evaluate count-based monitoring rates
cases.question: When I need several similar test cases, does the project prefer parameterized tests, and with which helper or library?
cases.note: Tests section: parameterize variations of the same behavior, `parameterized` in Python, `test.each` in Jest.

cases.task: fix(oauth): accept sign-in-only cimd scopes and name cimd failures
cases.question: Which commands should I run to lint, format and type-check Python changes before pushing — ruff and mypy?
cases.note: commands Lint: `ruff check . --fix`, `ruff format .`; code-style Python: `uv run mypy --cache-fine-grained .` repo-wide.

cases.task: refactor(frontend): move members logic to models and drop preflight shim
cases.question: How do I run TypeScript type-checking and linting for the frontend before opening a PR?
cases.note: Lint list: `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend typescript:check`, plus `fix`/`lint` (Oxlint/Oxfmt) scripts.

cases.task: Run project commands in a fresh shell where tools like pnpm or the expected Python version are missing
cases.question: Commands fail with 'command not found' or the wrong Python version; do I need to activate a project environment like flox first?
cases.note: Environment list: prefer `flox activate -- bash -c "<command>"` if commands fail; never interactive `flox activate`.

cases.task: Set up a local development environment and run PostHog
cases.question: How do I bring up the full local dev stack — Docker services, the Django backend, frontend dev server and workers?
cases.note: Build > Start dev: `./bin/start` or `hogli start` (TUI); detached `hogli up -d` with `hogli wait`/`hogli down`.

cases.task: chore(ci): install only hogli for workflow lint
cases.question: What is hogli, and which of its commands should I use for everyday tasks like starting services or running checks?
cases.note: Lists everyday hogli commands: test, start, up -d/wait/down, build:openapi, devex:feedback; other docs mention single commands only in passing.

cases.task: chore(ci): narrow the openapi codegen checkout
cases.question: How are frontend API client types generated from the Django OpenAPI spec, and when do I need to regenerate them?
cases.note: `hogli build:openapi` generates TS via drf-spectacular+Orval; regenerate after changing serializers/viewsets (commands repeats it briefly).

cases.task: chore(frontend): flag components that use a stylesheet they do not import
cases.question: Should new frontend components be styled with Tailwind utility classes, or with their own SCSS stylesheet?
cases.note: code-style#frontend: 'Use tailwind utility classes over inline styles'; SCSS stylesheets are not mentioned explicitly.

cases.task: fix(data-warehouse): tell users how to fix an invalid sendgrid api key
cases.question: How should user-facing error messages be worded so users understand what went wrong and how to fix it?
cases.note: Errors and empty states guide, don't dead-end: say what happened and the next action; plain, direct language.

cases.task: feat(experiments): explain why no primary metric has users yet
cases.question: Are there product copy rules for UI text, such as sentence case, tone of voice, or words to avoid?
cases.note: Lists sentence case, AI-text tells and em dashes to avoid, plain language without jargon, and a direct, friendly, consistent tone.

cases.task: fix(hogql_query): Extend support for all projects under org
cases.question: What rules prevent data leaking between teams — must every queryset and HogQL query be filtered by team?
cases.note: Tenancy section: team_id on every tenant model, fail-closed scoped managers, for_team(); HogQL team filtering not covered.

cases.task: feat(signals): serve the personal inbox ranking via for_me endpoint and mcp tool
cases.question: How do I expose a backend API endpoint as a tool in the PostHog MCP server?
cases.note: MCP tools are generated from the OpenAPI spec via YAML config and codegen; endpoint schemas need help_text.

cases.task: chore(skills): add contents to four long skill references
cases.question: Where do agent skills live in the repo, and how should a skill's SKILL.md and reference files be organized?
cases.note: Skills: .agents/skills/ (hogli init:skill; invoke /writing-skills); single-product skills under products/<product>/. SKILL.md/reference layout not covered.

cases.task: chore(quill-charts): trim gauge comments
cases.question: What's the guidance on code comments — when are they wanted, and what kinds of comments should be left out?
cases.note: Comments section: explain why not what, one line, no change history/chat context, keep comments when moving code.

cases.task: Open a pull request for a finished change
cases.question: What format should commit messages and PR titles follow — conventional commits with a scope like feat(scope)?
cases.note: Intro says conventional commits for messages and PR titles; format <type>(<scope>): <description>, types, scope/lowercase rules.

cases.task: Write the description for a pull request
cases.question: What should a PR description include — motivation, how it was tested, screenshots for UI changes?
cases.note: PR descriptions: use pull_request_template.md structure, fill Agent context, screenshots for visual changes via hogli pr:upload-image.
